featured.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
featured.tldr: Halcyon, a text-to-image autoregressive model trained from scratch on 100M image-text pairs with no text-only pretraining, beats baselines built on pretrained language models while using 18 to 275 times less pretraining compute.

featured.title: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
featured.tldr: Intern Lumina U2 is a diffusion language model that represents each image position with eight discrete codes, handling image, video and 3D understanding plus image generation and editing in one network trained on Ascend NPUs.

featured.title: Post-Training Frontier Text-to-Image Models by Composing Preference and Rubric Rewards
featured.tldr: Composing a learned human-preference reward with prompt-specific rubric rewards post-trains text-to-image models while resisting reward hacking: FLUX.2-dev gains 69 Elo, and Ideogram 4 tops all open-source models on the Arena leaderboard.
